inputs.label: Public cfDNA insert-size QC
inputs.prompt: Summarize the insert-size distribution of this public paired-end human BAM, including observation count, mode, median, 90-150 bp fraction, fraction above 250 bp, filter counts, and interpretation context.

inputs.label: Simplex UMI consensus wrapper
inputs.prompt: Run preprocess_cfdna() on the prepared paired-end inline-UMI uBAM using the 6M11S+T read structure and simplex path; inspect each stage, UMI tags, sort order, and final indexed output.

inputs.label: Reciprocal duplex UMI consensus wrapper
inputs.prompt: Run preprocess_cfdna() twice on reciprocal paired UMIs with duplex=True; verify paired grouping, true-duplex output, tag topology, query-grouped filtering, coordinate sort, and index.

inputs.label: QC flags, bounds, and empty BAM
inputs.prompt: Run insert_size_qc() on public, flag-contaminated, empty, and alternate-bound BAM cases; verify the primary/PF/nonduplicate policy, invalid-bound failures, deterministic values, and contextual output.

inputs.label: Literal metacharacter paths and ten-call stability
inputs.prompt: Execute the complete wrapper using literal paths with spaces and shell metacharacters, then run the shipped suite including ten consecutive complete calls; verify argv-only execution and stable useful outputs.
